_template_metadata.description: Template for tracking architecture version history with rationale and traceability
_template_metadata.part_of: Reflow v3.15.0 - Architecture Synchronization Loop feature
_template_metadata.usage: Created and updated by tools/version_architecture.py during D-06.5 and TO-05-A05.6

version_history.rationale: Initial architecture design from SE-02 Systems Engineering Workflow

_field_descriptions.version: Semantic version (v{major}.{minor}.{patch}) - major for breaking changes, minor for additions, patch for internal changes
_field_descriptions.timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when architecture was versioned
_field_descriptions.change_type: Root cause category: requirements_creep, performance_optimization, technical_constraints, security_hardening, operational_reality, developer_mistake_fix, or initial_design
_field_descriptions.rationale: Human-readable explanation of WHY architecture changed - link to test failures, performance issues, requirements changes
_field_descriptions.similarity_score_before: Jaccard similarity between as-designed and as-built BEFORE architecture update (0.0-1.0, null for initial)
_field_descriptions.similarity_score_after: Jaccard similarity AFTER architecture update (should be >= 0.95 for successful synchronization)
_field_descriptions.changed_files: Array of architecture files that were versioned (relative paths from system_root)
_field_descriptions.test_evidence: Path to test results or evidence that triggered change (e.g., 'specs/machine/ote_artifacts.json'), null if not applicable
_field_descriptions.breaking_changes: Boolean - true if interface contracts changed, services removed, or other breaking changes
_field_descriptions.migration_notes: Optional human-readable notes for migrating from previous version, null if not needed
